english.meaning: to peck, as a bird does
english.note: Repeated 啄啄啄 imitates a bird pecking.

exampleSentences.english: It can’t fly either. It’s just pecking away like this.
exampleSentences.traditional: 又唔識飛喎。喺度啄啄啄啄啄啄啄噉樣。
